scope: Base UI consumption recipes; stable recipe__slot API; no new engine primitives

geometry.contentSpacing: Page100%, Container75%, Group50% of margin reference; Control wrapper25% of n; additional gap M/2.
geometry.pointerFloor: Checkbox/radio/switch nominal row2n; label growth follows content. Range retains its24px pointer floor.
geometry.ownership: Current standalone contract: references/geometry-spacing.md. Historical package/site recipes require separate migration.
geometry.framePolicy: Current Control: S=3n; M=(q−2)n/4; H=S+2M. Fixed square icon/glyph wrappers; font-sized glyph. See geometry-spacing.md.
geometry.marginOwnership: Margin includes the border: padding=margin-border. Page owns4d, Card3d, Tile surfaces2d; parent owns the gutter. Use plain field groups within existing cards.
geometry.spacingTerminology: Margin is outer-edge-to-content distance including border. Gutter is parent-owned sibling spacing. Native CSS margin, inset positioning and inset shadows retain their meanings.

specRules.scope: Historical recipe exceptions only; current Control/media slot geometry is in references/geometry-spacing.md.

geometry.radiusValidation: Containment noise allowance 0.05 CSS px; physical radius excess allowance 0.001 CSS px. Preserve exact geometry. Group validity reports the whole scope; independently paint each layer from physicalExcess <= 0.001. Containment or sibling errors must not square feasible parent/sibling radii. Report real conflicts separately; consumer owns measurement, binding and cleanup.

families.semantics: native checkbox/radio + associated label; fieldset/legend for group
families.geometry: Nominal row and mark2n; compact text n+5; checkbox radius n/2; glyph2n-2c; radio dot2n-4c; c=n/4. Mark-to-label gutter d; no row density padding. Wrapped/enlarged labels may grow the row.
families.behavior: Space checkbox, native radio arrow behavior; mixed via input.indeterminate; label activates input Pointer toggle/deselect retains the unchecked mark boundary when no ring is displayed; keyboard focus replaces it with the visible ring.
notFor: Use radio buttons, not independent checkboxes, for one mutually exclusive value.
Use a switch for an immediately applied binary setting; checkbox choices can be submitted together.

implementation.anatomy: label.choice__root > input.checkbox__control|input.radio__control + span; title/description compositions use span.choice__body containing title and choice__description; flat collections use ul.list__root > li.list__row > label.choice__root with row-owned padding; grouped choices use fieldset/legend
implementation.native: Native checked/disabled and radio exclusivity
implementation.javascript: Set indeterminate and synchronize group selection; when an error clears, remove only its aria-describedby ID and retain other help IDs. Restore that ID when the error returns.
implementation.fallback: Individual native controls remain usable; omit all-items control if its synchronization is unavailable

evidence.scope: native selection, disabled choices, first-line mark alignment, mixed/invalid application transitions and choice-card paint

implementation.selectionLimits: Dispatch the attempted selection to the validating owner before normalizing or reverting it. Reject excess choices while retaining prior accepted items and expose a local associated explanation. Do not filter the attempted choice before the owner can detect the violation.
implementation.contentSlots: Keep the two direct choice columns: native mark plus body. Put descriptions/metadata inside choice__body; omit decorative item IDs without a user task. Unavailable options retain disabled native-input anatomy rather than placing the body in the mark column.
implementation.groupMargin: Use fieldset.field-group__root[data-surface=plain] within a card; border/margin belongs to the outer card. Preserve a separate group frame only when it conveys an intentional independent group.

stateApplicability.ownership: Native input owns state; label/card reflects the associated input.
stateApplicability.unlistedStates: Not supplied by this pattern. Compose a semantically appropriate host when additional behavior is required; do not add state merely for visual completeness.

groupGeometry.anatomy: fieldset.field-group__root > legend + div.options__root; use data-surface=plain inside an existing card, or bordered group with 3d margin and resolved card radius. Never leave a native browser border as the design.
groupGeometry.choiceRadius: Resolve adjusted r-card=3*k*n; semantic groups inside one surface need not add another border.

nestedOptions.anatomy: div.choice__card > label.choice__root.choice__primary + div.choice__options containing separate checkbox labels. Do not nest controls inside the radio label.
nestedOptions.ownership: Primary radio alone owns selection paint; workspace-specific options stay within its container and retain independent state. Global options belong outside the choices.
nestedOptions.geometry: Container owns 1u padding; primary label has zero padding; options align to body column (icon + 1u) with 1u related gap.

authoringExample.placement: Inner editor has no page/card margin; supplied host owns margin. Standalone wrapper may add page__root.
authoringExample.verify: Check native association plus actual radio__control/checkbox__control styling, label/body gap and first-line alignment. Native association alone does not establish system geometry.

families.semantics: Native checkbox with switch role; switch__root label, switch__control, optional explicit switch__thumb and switch__label. Legacy empty tracks retain the pseudo-element thumb.
families.geometry: Nominal row and track height 2n; label uses compact control text n+5. Row may grow for wrapped/enlarged labels. Clearance c, thumb2n-2c, width2*thumb+2c, round track corners.
families.behavior: Space toggles; checked is authoritative; no mixed state
notFor: Not for mixed state or mutually exclusive choices.
Do not imply immediate application when a separate submit action is required; use a checkbox.

implementation.anatomy: label.switch__root > input[type=checkbox][role=switch] + span.switch__control[aria-hidden=true] + span
implementation.native: Native binary checked/disabled
implementation.javascript: Persist or apply setting changes
implementation.fallback: Native checked state remains operable; do not imply a saved remote setting

evidence.scope: native binary input, track geometry, disabled state and script-disabled operation; remote persistence excluded

stateApplicability.ownership: Native binary input owns state; track is decorative and never independently focusable.
stateApplicability.unlistedStates: Not supplied by this pattern. Compose a semantically appropriate host when additional behavior is required; do not add state merely for visual completeness.

motion.easing: Apple Smooth sampled spring; see references/apple-smooth-motion.md

families.trackRadius: Control radius including presentation factors, not mark radius; retained on the smaller track and inherited by the thumb.

families.semantics: native input range with label, min/max/step and output; numeric alternative for precise entry
families.geometry: frame=max(height,24px); thumb=icon; rail=margin/2; thumb centered on rail
families.behavior: Arrow keys step; Home/End endpoints; input/output must agree; numeric alternative uses same validation
notFor: Not for categories or an unknown/unbounded range.
Do not make a slider the only route to an exact value; offer validated numeric entry.

implementation.anatomy: input.range__root[type=range] with label and min/max/step; labelled numeric alternative and output
implementation.native: Native range and numeric keyboard entry
implementation.javascript: Synchronize values/output and validate shared value
implementation.fallback: Expose a single native input or a normal submitted numeric field; do not display an unsynchronized live value

evidence.scope: native range input, local range/number synchronization and static fallback; physical touch and every invalid application policy excluded

stateApplicability.ownership: Native range owns value and keyboard input; value endpoints are tested separately.
stateApplicability.unlistedStates: Not supplied by this pattern. Compose a semantically appropriate host when additional behavior is required; do not add state merely for visual completeness.

families.progress: Firefox uses native range progress; WebKit/Chromium use --ui-range-progress percentage. Initialize and update from (value-min)/(max-min), clamp 0..100, and repaint after programmatic value changes. CSS cannot observe live value changes alone.

families.semantics: label/control/help or error via describedby
families.geometry: Control height H=2n+2d, text n+6, icon2n, margin d including border; field-label type n+5, gutter d/2. Wrapping/enlarged text may grow.
families.behavior: Invalid includes visible text and programmatic state; readonly differs from disabled
notFor: Not for navigation or actions; use links or buttons.
Do not use placeholder text as the only label or color as the only validation message.

implementation.anatomy: div.field__root > label[for] + native control + described help/error; optional input-group__root inside field
implementation.native: Native editing, required, readonly and disabled
implementation.javascript: Application validation, error summary and persistence
implementation.fallback: Native form submission/constraint validation when an actual form endpoint exists; otherwise clearly local editing
implementation.statePaint: input-group__root owns invalid dashed border and focus outline; disabled group dims once including prefix; readonly remains readable and focusable. Native input owns state attributes and editing semantics.
implementation.descriptions: Persistent help remains associated across editing states. Visible errors add their ID to aria-describedby; correction/restore removes the error ID while retaining help. Application validation owns these transitions; hidden inactive errors are not current descriptions.

evidence.scope: editing, readonly/disabled, invalid boundary ownership and persistent/conditional descriptions; announcement behavior excluded

implementation.labelText: Keep label text and optional required mark in one inline text run; when using separate markup for the mark, wrap both in one span so the label layout does not split them into rows.
implementation.conditionalErrors: Use one declared input-to-error ID mapping for rendering, describedby and focus. Verify a conditional field error resolves to a visible nonempty element; hiding its requirement clears only that error and retains typed draft values.

reservationRecipe.scope: Local selection cap, conditional note, native email validity and save/restore. Consumer mounts definition explicitly; no review registration supplied.

requiredMarkers.anatomy: label > span containing label text and an optional aria-hidden marker, with input as sibling in field__root
requiredMarkers.css: Separate field__root labels are inline text runs (display:block); labels wrapping native controls retain their layout. Native required supplies semantics; punctuation is decorative.
requiredMarkers.verify: Marker shares the final label text baseline at narrow width and enlarged text; marker does not occupy a standalone vertical row.

composedInput.anatomy: input-group__root > optional input-group__leading + input-group__body (optional input-group__prefix, native input, optional input-group__suffix) + optional input-group__trailing
composedInput.geometry: Shared H, type and radius. Frame owns border-inclusive d edge; body adds d/2 inline padding, yielding 1.5d text edges like buttons. Parent gap is zero; body padding supplies media-to-text spacing once. Adjacent media/actions use gutter d; body affixes d/2. Input has no second frame or inline padding.
composedInput.stepper: Trailing type=button data-input-step=down|up controls. Explicitly call bindInputSteppers(root); call returned cleanup before rebinding. Native min/max/step and keyboard behavior remain authoritative. Emits bubbling input/change. Actions hide for readonly/disabled; step=any disables discrete stepping. Programmatic value writes must dispatch input/change.
composedInput.semantics: Label names native input. Decorative affixes require equivalent meaning in label/help. Invalid state requires aria-invalid and associated visible explanation.

implementation.placeholder: Use native placeholder for format examples, never as a label. Shared --ui-placeholder uses 55% of the inherited field text color mixed with transparent; opacity 1 avoids stacked dimming and adapts to the local palette. Inherit field font family/size/tracking/alignment; regular upright text. Prefix and suffix remain separate, real value excludes placeholder text.

stateApplicability.ownership: Native control owns editing state; field/help/error/group reflect the control and error association.
stateApplicability.unlistedStates: Not supplied by this pattern. Compose a semantically appropriate host when additional behavior is required; do not add state merely for visual completeness.

constraints: Apply intent to the supported component itself; intent on arbitrary ancestor containers is unsupported.
Do not combine secondary class with explicit intent; use data-appearance.
Not inherited by nested components. Labels/status text communicate meaning without color.
Field intent paints helper/error text and input border; does not set aria-invalid or supply validation.
Outline and ghost use an opaque paired soft surface to guarantee a known backdrop.
Disabled buttons retain paired paint with full opacity and a dashed border; disabled semantics are native.
Forced-colors uses system colors; palette fidelity is not forced.
For a neutral component, omit data-intent and use its default or secondary appearance. Explicit material intent is a named source palette, not an unannotated neutral control.
semanticPalettes.primaryPolicy: Opt-in primary uses source color-1. This is an explicit base-ui alias; the export does not name a primary palette. Legacy md-color-primary remains unchanged.

colorGroupPolicy.prime: Independent accent samples, not aliases for numbered Base stops. Solid fills and their hover/active states use Prime samples.
colorGroupPolicy.base: Broad tonal support for paired foregrounds, soft containers, soft interaction states and borders.
colorGroupPolicy.pairing: This export uses Base 950 on solid Primes in both schemes. White on prime fails normal text contrast. State progression is explicitly mapped and tested, not inferred from sample names.
colorGroupPolicy.scope: Applies to opt-in semantic components. Existing legacy md-color roles and unannotated selection controls are unchanged.

fieldActionComposition.use: One labelled field and its related command, aligned to control bottoms. Wrap command below when needed. Keep help after group and independent commands in their own actions__root.
fieldActionComposition.verification: FIELD_ACTION_ANATOMY and FIELD_ACTION_ALIGNMENT; inspect both sides of wrapping thresholds.

compactRecordChoice.use: Optional class on field__root; concise distinct options, stable values, wrapping full record detail. Not a universal field width.

textareaComposition.anatomy: Header(context) → body(editor) → footer(leading tools, trailing actions)
textareaComposition.margin: Editor inline text inset 1.5d including border, block inset d including border. Native textarea and text-editor__root share the rule; composition container retains d.
textareaComposition.behavior: Preserve draft across input modes. State local preview, attachment and service boundaries explicitly.

compositionReview.rule: Inspect initial, expanded and completed states for boundary ownership, readable overflow cues, helper width, baseline/text rails and next-action emphasis.

families.semantics: native button type=button unless deliberate submit
families.geometry: Current Control anatomy: 3n square icon/glyph wrappers, icon2n, glyph n+6, label3n high; W=n×Control ratio; E=M/2; label edge padding: base B=max(0,H/2−m−W); label-only adds B/2 per edge, one exposed edge adds B, occupied edges add none; independent of actual radius; required API input height=H. No empty slots. Excess wrapper budgets report conflicts without changing art or frame. See references/geometry-spacing.md. Media: 3n square, artwork3n, no internal padding; E gap remains. Media presence suppresses label edge padding on its side.
families.behavior: Accessible name for icon-only; busy requires actual behavior and status, not decorative spinner
notFor: Not for a destination URL; use an anchor.
Do not use a busy appearance without corresponding work and status.

implementation.anatomy: button[type] with accessible name; actions__root groups peer actions; use button__root secondary for a secondary action and button__root with data-appearance=ghost for a ghost action, not invented button-secondary__root aliases
implementation.native: Native activation, form submit/reset where deliberately used
implementation.javascript: Actual operation, busy lifecycle and status
implementation.fallback: Use genuine links/forms for no-script routes; hide or disable unavailable JS-only actions with an explanation

evidence.scope: group geometry, native activation/focus, disabled and actual local busy lifecycle; arbitrary operation safety excluded

neutralGhost.rule: Neutral ghost appearance uses the data attribute. A ghost class alone is not implemented and silently retains primary paint.

labelLayout.alignment: Label/value/text slots flex to fill remaining space. Leading only: logical end; trailing only: logical start; label only or both sides: center. Media-only pair: space-between. Media positions follow reading order; RTL mirrors start/end.
labelLayout.overflow: Default nowrap/ellipsis, min-inline-size 0; preserve full DOM accessible label. Optional text-run inherits alignment. Bare text buttons center and ellipsize. data-wrap opts into multiline; data-single-line fixed frame takes precedence.

implementation.outerClipping: Painted buttons own an outer content-clipping boundary matching their resolved radius. Clip descendant slots at that boundary, including intrinsic logos; keep slot dimensions, label edge padding and artwork-authored styles unchanged. This is separate from optional media-wrapper shape inheritance. Keep focus rings on the button and required-geometry conflict diagnostics in an external, unclipped layer.

mediaSlot.anatomy: span[data-slot=media] > img or svg; optional data-media=avatar for cover/circular mask; logo uses contain
mediaSlot.semantics: Use alt="" or aria-hidden when redundant with label; meaningful standalone media requires an accessible name. No empty placeholder slots.
mediaSlot.geometry: --g-media = 3n; zero internal padding; fixed square. Arbitrary asset transparency is not wrapper padding.
mediaSlot.shape: Default avatar circle / logo intrinsic. Opt in with data-media-shape=control, resolveMediaRadius from assets/geometry/control.mjs and --media-required-radius. Immediate parent required radius; actual measured cap; Sharp exempt; report conflicts without clamping.

colorStates.primary: Paired action/on-action at rest; atomic foreground/background reversal on hover. Current filled buttons have no inset stroke at rest or active. Focus retains its shared ring.
colorStates.secondary: Surface/ink at rest; action/on-action on hover and active. Current outline stroke uses --ui-control-border (default --ui-border; intent outlines --ui-intent-border), independent of text and layout geometry.
colorStates.ghost: Transparent rest; action/on-action on hover and active; border remains transparent.
colorStates.verification: Measure actual background and foreground together in both schemes at rest, focus, hover and active. Disabled hover does not change its pair. Custom surfaces and authored overrides require their own contrast check.

stateApplicability.ownership: Button owns interaction state; action/group containers arrange buttons and have no independent activation.
stateApplicability.unlistedStates: Not supplied by this pattern. Compose a semantically appropriate host when additional behavior is required; do not add state merely for visual completeness.

families.composition: Within one task action group, emphasize the primary commit; use existing secondary/ghost appearances for reset and help. Expose one authoritative current save status near the group; draft edits replace prior success messaging without erasing the last saved snapshot. Apply draft invalidation to every save-success output, including optional notification banners. Notification preference is independent; a save confirmation is revision-bound. Retained historical receipts must identify the last saved revision.

commandRouting.hook: button[type=button][data-action]; payload attributes stay on button; view cache uses separate attributes
commandRouting.ownership: Native button activation; runtime scopes action routing to nearest native button. A state attribute on a container is not an action.

Do not combine secondary class with explicit intent; use data-appearance.
Not inherited by nested components. Labels/status text communicate meaning without color.
Field intent paints helper/error text and input border; does not set aria-invalid or supply validation.
Outline and ghost use an opaque paired soft surface to guarantee a known backdrop.
Disabled buttons retain paired paint with full opacity and a dashed border; disabled semantics are native.
Forced-colors uses system colors; palette fidelity is not forced.
For a neutral component, omit data-intent and use its default or secondary appearance. Explicit material intent is a named source palette, not an unannotated neutral control.
semanticPalettes.primaryPolicy: Opt-in primary uses source color-1. This is an explicit base-ui alias; the export does not name a primary palette. Legacy md-color-primary remains unchanged.

colorGroupPolicy.prime: Independent accent samples, not aliases for numbered Base stops. Solid fills and their hover/active states use Prime samples.
colorGroupPolicy.base: Broad tonal support for paired foregrounds, soft containers, soft interaction states and borders.
colorGroupPolicy.pairing: This export uses Base 950 on solid Primes in both schemes. White on prime fails normal text contrast. State progression is explicitly mapped and tested, not inferred from sample names.
colorGroupPolicy.scope: Applies to opt-in semantic components. Existing legacy md-color roles and unannotated selection controls are unchanged.

fieldActionComposition.use: One labelled field and its related command, aligned to control bottoms. Wrap command below when needed. Keep help after group and independent commands in their own actions__root.
fieldActionComposition.verification: FIELD_ACTION_ANATOMY and FIELD_ACTION_ALIGNMENT; inspect both sides of wrapping thresholds.

controlRail.use: Opt-in related secondary commands and disclosure share outer and text rails. Boxed controls use2u inline margin. Within narrow reading-flow__root both flatten inline borders/margins together; preserve block borders, focus and target size. Do not use for primary commits or unrelated adjacent components.
controlRail.verification: Measure actual text range starts and outer edges in closed/open and narrow/wide states, not padding equality alone.

renderRestoration.when: Custom render replaces descendants whose focus or disclosure-open state should persist
renderRestoration.ownership: Consumer chooses persistent state and completion destination. Stable IDs are data, not selectors. Explicit navigation focus takes precedence.
renderRestoration.removedTrigger: restoreUIRestoration(root,snapshot,{fallbackFocusId}) restores a declared programmatically focusable status/heading if the old target is removed, hidden or disabled. No prior focus inside root means no focus steal. Return focus is restored/fallback/not-requested/unresolved; test document.activeElement after confirmation removes its trigger.

canvasComposition.scope: Optional nonmodal canvas overlays; selection preserves camera/layout, explicit fit accounts for overlays. Signals/problems/verified outcomes retain distinct supported meanings. Not native dialog replacement.
canvasComposition.layout: createCanvasOverlayLayout(root,host,{inspector,controls,player}): measured inspector exclusivity, control restoration and playback-space reservation; actual action reachability checks required

geometry.radius: k·2n via --r-widget, shared corner policy applied once

nestedControlLadder.geometry: Button → Chip → Badge uses H = 2n + k·d with k = 2, 1, 0. Apply data-control-ladder to the Button and Chip parents: each owns d/2 border-inclusive clearance per nesting edge (CSS padding d/2 − B), instead of adding full standalone padding again. At n=8, Regular/Compact/Tight heights are 32/24/16, 28/22/16 and 24/20/16. These are nominal minima; enlarged or wrapped content may grow frames. Use static elements for the containment specimen, never nested interactive buttons. Curvature remains Independent.
nestedControlLadder.status: Legacy compatibility only; not current Control anatomy.

compositionReview.rule: Inspect initial, expanded and completed states for boundary ownership, readable overflow cues, helper width, baseline/text rails and next-action emphasis.

families.semantics: tabs for panels; pressed buttons for independent mode selection; links for destinations
families.geometry: Segments fill available inline space; direct buttons share equal widths and stretch to the tallest label. Labels wrap within their segment; tabs retain their scrolling layout.
families.behavior: Tabs require roving tabindex and arrows/Home/End; panels hidden; pressed mode changes its actual target Disabled tabs are excluded from roving focus and activation; Home/End target the first/last enabled tab.
families.breadcrumbLayout: Baseline-aligned wrapping ordered list; direct li margins reset; parent gap uses local gutter. Long labels may wrap without horizontal overflow.
notFor: Do not style radio inputs as tabs unless they actually select a form value; tabs need panel and keyboard behavior.
Breadcrumbs represent location hierarchy, not a sequential task stepper.

breadcrumbAnatomy.children: direct li; ancestors are anchors; current item has aria-current=page

implementation.anatomy: nav > ol.breadcrumbs__root > li for hierarchy; tablist > buttons with matching labelled panels for tabs
implementation.native: Links navigate; native radio groups select values
implementation.javascript: Tabs need roving focus, arrows/Home/End and panel state; modes change their target
implementation.fallback: Without a tab controller, expose labelled sections and ordinary anchor navigation instead of inert tab roles

evidence.scope: current link/breadcrumb geometry, tab roving focus and disabled skipping, segmented paint and static section fallback

stateApplicability.ownership: Navigation subpattern determines native ownership; no generic disabled-link behavior.
stateApplicability.unlistedStates: Not supplied by this pattern. Compose a semantically appropriate host when additional behavior is required; do not add state merely for visual completeness.

containedRadius.outer: Independent control radius; explicit profile consumers resolve using group height and margin d/2 plus container margin.
containedRadius.margin: Container margin d/2; data-compact removes it (0). Border is inset paint.
containedRadius.inner: Inset: max(0, group radius - container margin); inherit corner shape.
containedRadius.scope: Segmented options are an explicit inset pattern, alongside listbox options.

filterAnatomy.children: direct button[type=button][aria-pressed]; one true for exclusive filtering
filterAnatomy.behavior: Update every aria-pressed value and actual target together via onAction. Bind the optional maintained indicator helper for two moving backgrounds; static CSS still paints selection without it. Native Tab/Enter/Space; no listbox or tab roles for mode selection.

segmentedGeometry.marginBudget: Container margin d/2; data-compact sets only this margin to 0. Gap d/4. Options use Hc=2n+d, half-margin padding and compact text n+5; wrapped text grows all options.
segmentedGeometry.radius: Parent independent, options inset by actual container margin. Compact keeps option dimensions and gutter.
segmentedGeometry.indicators: bindSegmentIndicators from assets/recipes/segment-indicators.js measures separate selected and hover pseudo-element backgrounds. Selected shape paints above hover; labels paint above both. Idle hover is transparent at selected bounds; fresh hover seeds there before moving/fading to its target. Leave fades and returns to selected bounds. Selection changes semantics immediately; hover never selects. Consumer owns aria-pressed and target update.
segmentedGeometry.motion: Transform/size/opacity only; shared duration/easing. Reduced motion and forced colors disable transitions. Dispatch segmentgeometrychange after external radius changes; resize and selected-attribute changes refresh automatically.
segmentedGeometry.verification: Check independent hover/selection, keyboard activation, disabled options, resize, profile changes and reduced motion; compare compact/standard option dimensions.
segmentedGeometry.indicatorInset: Selected and hover segment backgrounds share the same border protection. Compact (zero container margin) insets both by B per edge: position +B, dimensions −2B, radius max(0, option radius−B). With standard container margins, both use the full option bounds and radius. Per-edge paint inset is max(0, option border width − container padding), so existing margins are not charged twice. Transparent hover starts at the protected selected bounds. This changes paint only, not layout or hit targets.

taskColumns.anatomy: two direct children: chooser then detail
taskColumns.geometry: Flex wrap from local font-relative bases18em and32em, gap3d; preserves DOM order and wraps sooner when text grows. No viewport-only fixed sidebar.

families.semantics: native table/caption/th scope; lists for non-tabular content
families.geometry: Control rows: S=3n; m=(q−2)n/4; minH=S+2m. Center minimum S slots; multiline grows. Inline cell P=m+W; block m; column gutter E=m/2. Collapsed tables reserve E/2 on internal facing cell edges, data-list grids use gap E. One row-only --ui-data-divider, no cell borders/shadows.
families.behavior: Sort button updates order and aria-sort; visible filtering and all-visible selection agree; retain hidden selection when specified Empty filtered results show a recovery hint, disable all-visible selection, and retain prior row selection when the filter is cleared.
notFor: Do not use tables for page layout or unrelated cards.
Do not expose grid roles for a static table without implementing grid keyboard interaction.

implementation.anatomy: table.table__root with caption, scoped headers and body inside table__viewport; non-tabular ul.list__root > li.list__row with list__body, either a direct content body or a choice__body inside an associated label.choice__root
implementation.native: Native table/list reading order
implementation.javascript: Sorting, filtering, selection coordination and aria-sort
implementation.fallback: Static data stays readable; omit unavailable sorting/filter controls
implementation.listStates: Native checkboxes own list selection; application filtering hides rows without clearing checks, and sorting moves existing rows. Announce order through a status region, not aria-sort on list items. Empty collections render no row/body content and show recovery guidance. See list-states recipe.

evidence.scope: static table/list semantics, filtering/sorting, retained selection, empty recovery and inherited row geometry

taskAccess.rule: Choose the next meaningful task and justify mobile access distance. Use bounded collections or explicit focus navigation when long content precedes it; preserve all content and keyboard access.

stateApplicability.ownership: Collection controller owns data state; wrapper/row/body reflect data and native table/list semantics.
stateApplicability.unlistedStates: Not supplied by this pattern. Compose a semantically appropriate host when additional behavior is required; do not add state merely for visual completeness.

selectionColumn.anatomy: th[scope=col][data-selection] contains the select-visible checkbox with accessible name; row td[data-selection] cells contain individually named checkboxes
selectionColumn.geometry: Column hugs the checkbox target plus inherited cell gutters; does not share surplus table width
selectionColumn.behavior: Header selects visible rows, reflects mixed selection, and disables when no rows are visible

recordSelection.anatomy: Named group of button.record-choice__root[type=button][aria-pressed] before adjacent detail; one pressed record for exclusive selection.
recordSelection.behavior: Activation updates pressed state and detail together. Ordinary Tab/Enter/Space; not a listbox or multi-row checkbox selection.
recordSelection.paint: Selected media-base/ink and label border; metadata keeps normal weight and no underline. After blur selection remains visible in both schemes. Visible focus outline replaces the border; pointer focus without an outline retains state border paint.
recordSelection.geometry: Card options: 2u margin, 1u title/metadata gap, card radius. Direct td/th or inline records: control minimum height/radius, 0.5u block/1.5u inline margins, centered content. Wrapping grows height; no extra text-slot margin. Table sort-header styling applies only to column headers with aria-sort and excludes record choices; row headers retain these gutters.

commandRouting.hook: button[type=button][data-action]; payload attributes stay on button; view cache uses separate attributes
commandRouting.ownership: Native button activation; runtime scopes action routing to nearest native button. A state attribute on a container is not an action.

scrollAffordance.anatomy: Visible table__hint associated through aria-describedby with a named tabindex=0 table__viewport region; native table/caption/scoped headers remain inside.
scrollAffordance.behavior: Hint explains horizontal scrolling if columns extend beyond the view. Keep local scrolling with hidden scrollbar chrome; the hint supplies discoverability. Do not break words to fit.

operationComposition.scope: Incident review/resolution, not universal table layout.
operationComposition.order: Chooser before detail; within one task group: detail, evidence, bounded plan, Resolve. Preserve narrow DOM order.
operationComposition.layout: Optional queue/task columns align at start. Use section/field/related gaps; avoid equal-height cards and repeated margins.
operationComposition.firstView: Identity/status together first, secondary metadata later. Bound/wrap titles; keep short words whole.
operationComposition.overflow: Named focusable local scroll region and visible hint; inspect all columns.

families.recordIdentifierSizing: record-id__root is allowed on a short-identifier-only button.record-choice__root or an inner span containing only the identifier. Both use nowrap and intrinsic max-content width; existing control margin remains authoritative. Longer labels belong outside that unbroken subpart. Table overflow stays in table__viewport.

renderRestoration.when: Custom render replaces descendants whose focus or disclosure-open state should persist
renderRestoration.ownership: Consumer chooses persistent state and completion destination. Stable IDs are data, not selectors. Explicit navigation focus takes precedence.
renderRestoration.removedTrigger: restoreUIRestoration(root,snapshot,{fallbackFocusId}) restores a declared programmatically focusable status/heading if the old target is removed, hidden or disabled. families.semantics: Conserved whole-unit allocation fieldset with associated labels and total feedback
families.behavior: validateAllocation accepts nonnegative safe integer total and explicit nonnegative integer parts; rejects blank, negative, fractional and overflow values; requires exact sum. renderAllocation does not mutate drafts. Host owns inputs, attempted-error timing and commit gating; revalidate at commit and bind decisions to source revision.

families.semantics: Native kbd.kbd__root for a key or whole chord. One cap displays plus-separated keys, e.g. ⌘+K, with an expanded accessible name. Passive content: no tabindex, action binding or button role.
families.geometry: Badge sizing: minimum square 2n, type n+4, zero block padding and border-inclusive d/2 inline padding. Badge curvature context (margin d/2, frame 2n). Named keys and whole chords grow intrinsically; groups wrap between caps, never inside chords.
families.behavior: Display keyboard input hints only; does not register shortcuts.

limits: Recipes expose baseline styling, not full implementations of every state.
Tree, date-picker, rich-text and grid are bounded local examples with explicit exclusions in their family contracts. Searchable combobox is single-value; multi-select uses native checkboxes.
Native disclosure markers and platform numeric spinners are browser affordances, not substitute icon assets.
State paint and segmented indicator motion use shared timing; reduced motion disables animation.

implementationDefaults.css: Shared stylesheet owns geometry, shape, scheme and visual states. Consumers may compose layout; token usage alone does not prove readable nesting.
implementationDefaults.verification: Recipe checks are bounded evidence. State coverage, assistive technology and older browser floors require separate reports.

classGroups.use: Card owns one surface margin. Media reserves illustrative space; inverse surfaces rebind all foreground roles. A semantic subsection need not be another card.
Immediate parent owns layout and relationship gaps. Choose page/section/field/related context; do not accumulate per-child margins.

fieldAction.use: One labelled field and its related command, aligned to control bottoms. Wrap command below when needed. Keep help after group and independent commands in their own actions__root.
fieldAction.verification: FIELD_ACTION_ANATOMY and FIELD_ACTION_ALIGNMENT; inspect both sides of wrapping thresholds.

controlRail.use: Opt-in related secondary commands and disclosure share outer and text rails. Boxed controls use2u inline margin. Within narrow reading-flow__root both flatten inline borders/margins together; preserve block borders, focus and target size. Do not use for primary commits or unrelated adjacent components.
controlRail.verification: Measure actual text range starts and outer edges in closed/open and narrow/wide states, not padding equality alone.

classGroups.use: Choose product versus explicit editorial context. Eyebrows supplement, not replace, semantic headings.
Subparts of fields/choices, not standalone controls. Plain field groups preserve semantics without a second padded surface.
Shell/header/sidebar anatomy; native links and controls retain interaction ownership. Row slots preserve control geometry.

sidebarAnatomy.geometry: outer margin/2, section gap gutter/2, row inline margin, icon gap gutter, row minimum height=height; nested link guide aligned to icon center
sidebarAnatomy.behavior: Native links, details and account popover. Sidebar disclosures are unboxed navigation groups with no open-header shadow, a scoped exception to standalone contained disclosures.
sidebarAnatomy.paint: Muted neutral current surface, neutral hover; foreground remains paired with surface. Shared state transitions apply. Rounded composition shells own the background; child sidebar surfaces stay transparent so square child paint cannot cover shell corners. Do not clip keyboard focus to repair paint overlap.

classGroups.use: Native source-inspection button with two equal decorative spans. Shared zero gap/padding and one control radius; declare exact light/dark paint and an accessible token-specific name. Native popover owns opening/dismissal.

Collections owns recordIdentifierSizing: use on a short-identifier-only record-choice button or an inner identifier span. Preserve control margin and scoped table overflow; longer labels remain outside the unbroken identifier.

stateEvidenceBoundary: stateApplicability declares supported states and ownership, not test completion. planning state audit and browser reports track observed coverage separately. Subpart reflection is not independent interactivity.

essentialBoundaryPaint.scope: Authored computed boundary paint against interior/exterior, selected glyphs, switch states and input-group focus; excludes normal slider raster paint and exhaustive interaction/accessibility coverage.
essentialBoundaryPaint.focusReplacement: When a visible replacement focus ring is painted, its component boundary becomes transparent immediately; retain border width and restore state paint when the ring is no longer displayed. Pointer focus without a replacement ring retains the ordinary boundary, including an unchecked choice mark. Input-group paints a focus-within ring and owns that boundary; switch track owns its focus-visible ring and margin border paint; disclosure owns the summary focus-visible boundary. Do not clear unrelated ancestor borders or internal slider anatomy.

stateMotion.scope: Authored buttons, controls, selection rows, navigation and disclosure state paint, including supported pseudo-elements
exceptions: Reduced motion and forced colors use zero duration
Native platform popup rendering is browser-owned
Visibility, layout, selected semantics and slider value updates remain immediate; do not use transition:all
Opposite foreground/background reversal is atomic to preserve contrast through the transition; outline and shadow retain shared motion.

consumerVerification.rule: Retrieve contracts again when a new family is introduced, including dynamic DOM. Audit the final application in relevant states; kit specimen checks do not validate consumer anatomy.
consumerVerification.scope: Rendered family discovery, disclosure anatomy/margin and stacked evidence gaps; not general UI conformance.

containerSpacing.verification: audit-rendered checks default margins, page gap and disclosure alignment; custom layouts require separate evidence
containerSpacing.measurement: Margins include borders; CSS padding subtracts the local border width.

schemeSelection.mechanism: Root data-theme sets CSS color-scheme, which selects light-dark() token values. Remove the attribute to follow the foundation default. Do not use data-scheme.
schemeSelection.verification: Change only data-theme; verify computed color-scheme and actual foreground/background change, not only attribute state.

classNaming.compatibility: Version 4 canonical names only; no legacy aliases. Semantic variables use --ui-*; action dispatch uses data-action.

specDataList.wrapping: Within the value column, including formulas; preserve paired rows at narrow widths
specDataList.ownership: Teaching specifications stay outside the example canvas; product data such as invoice totals remains inside its artifact.

headingDescriptionData.heading: Semantic heading; own spanning grid row; peer heading color
headingDescriptionData.content: Description fills column; prose and data list share top edge
headingDescriptionData.responsive: Stack heading, description, list when columns no longer fit

canvasOwnership.helper: section(id, title, description, body, specification); teaching specs use the fifth argument
canvasOwnership.exception: Home measured-select height/width/radius annotations stay on canvas; not a general exception for teaching lists
canvasOwnership.verification: Inspect narrow/wide wrapping and ancestry; do not infer product versus teaching ownership from dl/spec-list alone

nativeSelectContainment.rule: Constrain wrapper width, preserve select width:100%, and keep the decorative indicator within the painted native frame

artifactReview.boundary: Every rendered specimen has a grid canvas; data-review-id identifies it and data-artifact identifies reusable content. Teaching specs remain outside.
artifactReview.staleEvidence: Rebuild and recapture; never promote stale evidence.
artifactReview.conditionalGeometry: Do not resolve curvature from hidden zero-sized controls; recompute when content opens.

geometryRecipeLibrary.scope: Local geometry-driven recipe pages; site-specific intent palette; no service integration

commands.focus: Return to invoker after dismiss/action; Tab exits context menu; outside dismissal preserves clicked focus
commands.menuRowGeometry: Full Control menuitem/menuitemcheckbox/menuitemradio rows: H=3n+2m; m=(q−2)n/4 on every edge, fixed 3n slots, W wrapper padding, E=m/2 gaps, zero button label edge padding. Outer menu padding is separate. Ordinary Listbox selection rows stay 3n. Resolve each row with resolveControlSurface and validate its measured radius independently.

icons.slot: 3n square for icon/glyph; full3n zero-padding media
icons.scope: Current Control slots; legacy recipe exceptions require their owning contract.

referenceSiteArchitecture.scope: Paths relative to mathematical-design-system/assets/site; build generated HTML/runtime in place and preserve maintained styles

homeHero.scope: Reference Home and explicit adaptations; not every page
homeHero.measurements: First control: live height, auto width and resolved radius on canvas; visible by default
homeHero.selection: Separate highlight from committed value; aria-expanded/controls/activedescendant and named listbox options
homeHero.toggle: Stable accessible name, aria-pressed, initially on; independent favorite state, no chip mode
homeHero.geometry: Shared context and maintained slots; ghost changes paint only
homeHero.verification: mathematical-design-system/scripts/check-home-hero.cjs plus site checks and visual review
